connectorUiConfig.title: Workday Email Activity (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Collect completed Email ID Change events from a Workday Report-as-a-Service (RaaS) custom report into ASimAuditEventLogs. This custom connector is not the Microsoft Workday User Activity connector and does not support WQL endpoints. The report must return all matching rows in one Report_Entry array and honor After_Date_Time and Before_Date_Time prompts.

sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventProduct == "Workday" and Operation == "Email Activity"
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUserId, ActorUsername, Object, OldValue, NewValue, EventOriginalUid
| take 100

dataTypes.name: {{graphQueriesTableName}}
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventProduct == "Workday" and Operation == "Email Activity"
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Workday RaaS and OAuth access
customs.description: An OAuth authorization-code API client with a Bearer access token, report access for the authorizing user, and the Workday functional-area permissions required by the custom report.

instructionSteps.title: Prepare the Workday custom report and API client
instructionSteps.description:
1. Enable OAuth 2.0 clients in Workday tenant security settings.
2. Enable the Email ID Change report as a web service. Confirm it returns Report_Entry with DateTimeStamp, EmailIDAfter, EmailIDBefore, Employee_ID, Login_ID, TargetID, and Worker. DateTimeStamp must be an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone. Configure After_Date_Time and Before_Date_Time prompts to return the complete five-minute interval without pagination or truncation.
3. Register an API client with Authorization Code Grant and Bearer access tokens. Grant the functional-area permissions required by this report and authorize with a user permitted to run it.
4. Register exactly this redirect URI: https://portal.azure.com/TokenAuthorize/ExtensionName/Microsoft_Azure_Security_Insights
5. Retrieve token and authorization URLs from View API Clients in the same Workday tenant. Do not copy example hosts or use a WQL URL.
6. Enter credentials only in the OAuth form below. Click Connect once and complete Workday consent. Each attempt must obtain a fresh authorization code; do not deploy placeholder or previously redeemed codes.
